title: Very mixed feelings
text:
I have very mixed feelings about this whole subscription:
Pros: the colors of product/kitchen tool is vibrant and bright. Everything my daughter has received so far has been good quality and I've actually used hers instead.
The "recipe" is lamented which is nice for beginner cooks.
It always ships on time and in tacked.

That's about it though bc my cons list is higher...in fact, and I was typing the pros, I kept wanting to say, "ya BUT". So here are my Ya BUT:
There has yet to be a month where I thought, "Wow, that was total worth the subscription price" and actually I only kept it coming bc I thought maybe they were starting out slow and simplistic to make sure kids and their parents were enjoying and kept the monthly subscription going, but NOPE, most months are really pretty pathetic on which kitchen tool comes.
The products ARE quality, like I mentioned above, I even enjoy using them at times. BUT the choice of tools AND the recipes are way out there for the most part and NOT something beginner little chefs would even WANT to eat, let alone spending their time learning to try to make.
Which brings my next con...I've noticed the grocery product list get pretty pricey and are not always sold in every day grocery stores or in smaller quantities. Instead, you end up either going from store to store, buying it on Amazon/somewhere online and wait days for arrival, or your young chef gives up and the recipe is never made, which brings you back to comments about price and kids really wanting to learn to cook.
I gave this a try for a solid year before canceling. What was even more sad is my now 14 yr old loved getting a fun surprise each month but didn't bat an eye, yell/fight about deciding to cancel etc, instead was actually happy about it bc she said she felt guilty about receiving something she never used. I could have purchased her ... anything else with the money wasted on this subscription. Heck, I could have and should have (maybe I still will) actual cooking lessons from one of the local grocers. I could have taken them with her and made fun memories instead of all this. Boo, wish I could get my money back, would even give everything received back as well.
label: negative
